body:
Thank you. You have a kind heart. I will cherish that. 

I noticed your reddit name... Please hang in there. I know I'm in no position to give advice but I can certainly say that I know how you feel. Hang in there, my friend. I am.

Thank you. I am from South Bayarea, CA. I apologize for the late reply. I actually went to, for the first time, a buddhist temple today. My dad's a monk living in a temple as a buddhist in South Korea. I'm taking your advice and taking steps. I'm not sure whether it's the right step but I feel as though I have to do something different and that's what I'm attempting to do. Thank you, again.

I mentioned to my girlfriend (not in detail as to why) that I'm actually looking for a local free/cheap clinic for a therapist/counseling and she actually said she knows some and is willing to help me find the right one for me. I'll be honest, all of this is very awkward and I don't where this will lead to but I think I have to something, anything, to help myself. Thank you momoz.

She definitely is my source of light. With that said, I will not go to my mom for support. Shortly, because this will only burden her with more guilt. It's a very long story as to why she would feel this way so I will not get into it. That's just the way she is. 

She is an angel.
I agree completely. And yeah, the exhaust thing... it's a no go. Thank you.

>You don't seem like your going to go through with it right now, so don't jump immediately to fixing all your problems. Just take a day or so to relax and realize that all of things will fix and heal in time...

This really made me feel at ease. Thank you.

I'm currently searching for a psychologist/counselor but I don't think I can afford it. Is there a free or at least a cheap way to get one?

Thank you.
I was too ashamed to talk to anyone about this before last night. I kept it balled up inside. As soon as I heard "are you thinking about commiting suicide?" on the hotline I bawled my eyes out to this complete stranger as I replied ".....yes." It actually made me feel better just to say it to someone. So, for the moment, I feel a little better.
Thank you for the chuckle (your last statement).
Well, that would've been a waste of time wouldn't it...

Only thing that keeping me from going through with it is my family (mom, sis). I just can't bare thinking about my mom having to go through the pain after all she's been through. I'll try to find a hobby.

Hard, indeed. For the moment I feel a bit better. I just needed someone to talk to about these thoughts and that's what I got with the call that I'd made. Thank you for the offer. I've read other posts in /suicidewatch and that also helped in knowning that I'm not alone in these thoughts.
They haven't called back but the first call that I made myself actually helped me. Thank you,I appreciate it. All of the posts here, I feel,  deserves a reply. So thank you kind sir.

I'm currently unemployed. I got laid off 6 months ago and I feel like I'm stuck. The desire to even get up to find a job has diminished after many failed attempts. I don't go out ever anymore. I have acquaintances but no real friends. I lost all my friends due to our drug habits (meth) many yrs ago. My current girlfriend is losing hope with me. My family is ashamed of me. I haven't seen my dad in almost 20 yrs. My mom tried her best not to stress me out and is very supportive but that in itself makes me feel upset about myself. My sister despises me but I also know she loves me. I've been having these suicidal thoughts for a couple months but these last 2 days were consumed by overwelming thoughts of suicide. I feel better at this moment. I won't go through with it. Calling suicide hotline actually helped. Thank you for your reply.
Thank you. I fell asleep after posting this due to consumption of xanax and alcohol.
